svg.title: SCARAB complete software workflow
svg.desc: Numbered conceptual modules with inputs, computational steps, data products and optional branches. See the workflow guide for source-code references and execution order.

g.text: SCARAB Python controller • Local command or one Slurm job
Input validation • Output lock and provenance • Tool threads and worker pools • Reuse of matching completed runs
Assembly FASTA + read-library list (paired FASTQs or supported single-file reads)
Optional: trusted genome/scaffold FASTAs for anchored recruitment
Defaults: 10 kb windows; 2 kb overlap; 2 kb minimum length
Optional: requires trusted references with usable matches
Reads map to assembly windows; composition is computed from the same windows
Reference-based selection does not retrain against ground truth for the new sample
With references, candidate MinHash hits inform the feature subset
Optional: both branches use qualifying anchors and the shared embedding
The intersect product is not a strict three-way intersection
Optional: scarab reassemble; paired short reads; same installed environment
Genome quality control and biological interpretation remain downstream user analyses
